decision.reason: [ev-914f3976650c] is only an optional pointer under "Start using v2 features" ("Try the ... getting started guide"). That suggests an opt-in feature with no consequence for an operator who does nothing, which conflicts with the proposed behavior-change saying managed resources "now operate within Kubernetes namespaces rather than cluster-wide". [ev-f9df8ec77b1f] says "Crossplane v2 makes all managed resources (MRs) namespaced", but the excerpt is cut off and never says what happens to existing cluster-scoped MRs: whether they keep working, behave differently or stop working. To choose between none, behavior-change and a failure kind, the evidence needs the rest of the what's-new section, or upgrade-guide text that says whether existing cluster-scoped MRs stay supported after the upgrade.
